title: Underwriting Loading Schedule: Unit Age on Equipment & Vehicle Loans Collateral Protection
content:
**Loading.** The annual percentage of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans collateral protection premium carries an age loading set by the average model year of the units still securing the loan: 0.5 point is added when that average is more than 10 years before the calendar year of the placement date, 0.25 point when it is more than 5 but not more than 10 years before, and nothing otherwise. The premium is figured at the annual percentage with its age loading added.

## The average model year

The average model year is the sum of the model years of the units still securing the loan (units pledged less units since released) divided by the number of those units; it may fall between two years.

## Loading schedule

| Calendar year of placement less the average model year | Loading added to the annual percentage |
|---|---|
| more than 10 years | 0.5 point |
| more than 5 but not more than 10 years | 0.25 point |
| 5 years or fewer | none |

## Both sides of each step (hypothetical placement in 2026)

| Average model year | Years before 2026 | Loading |
|---|---|---|
| 2016 | 10 | 0.25 point |
| 2015.5 | 10.5 | 0.5 point |
| 2021 | 5 | none |
| 2020.5 | 5.5 | 0.25 point |

## Hypothetical illustration

Two units of model years 2012 and 2019 still secure a loan at a 2026 placement: the average model year is 2015.5, 10.5 years before 2026, so 0.5 point is added.
